results.name: Stage 0.4 SEE-V2X 通信指标科学复核

core_metrics.pdr_definition: full-run (denominator=all tx in run) is the valid sender-base rate
core_metrics.pdr_semantics_0_4_6_2: full-run = descriptive reception ratio; receive-window/field = window-conditional; receiver-online Unverified
core_metrics.latency_explanation_0_4_6_2: cross-run latency follows packet-size serialization (PHY/MAC), not clock offset

results.current_conclusion: Scientific correction (0.4.6.2): FULL-RUN PDR is a descriptive reception ratio (denominator=all tx in run); whether all sends are true receive opportunities (receiver online for the whole window) is Unverified - Run 2 boundary [0,150] may be device start/stop, not link loss. Full-run PDR is NOT auto the only valid link-loss rate; receive-window and field rates are window-conditional. Latency cross-run differences are EXPLAINED by real PHY/MAC serialization (packet size x priority, 50 Hz): latency rises with packet size (100B 8.8-11 ms, 5000B 24-26, 8000B 21.8-30) - NOT clock offset. Clock sync remains Unverified but does not drive the cross-run pattern. Calibration still frozen.

results.name: Stage 0.4 SEE-V2X BSM 通信证据科学复核
results.current_conclusion: Pairing (1.0) separated from reception ratio (0.22-1.0); true link PDR and receive opportunity Unverified (GNSS presence does not prove wireless receiver online; indoor has no GNSS; RSU static); clock epoch x1000 ambiguity keeps absolute latency Unverified; distance only outdoor 0-10m. Controlled-PC5 descriptive candidate parameters only; formal calibration still frozen.

results.name: Stage 0.4 SEE-V2X GNSS 时空匹配修复与证据收束

core_metrics.closure: SEE-V2X stage closed; controlled-PC5 candidate reference only

results.current_conclusion: GNSS matcher repaired (no edge clamp, real-neighbour error, track-identity check). KEY: t1/t2/t3 GNSS tracks are point-for-point identical (replicated track) -> inter-device distance NOT identifiable (d=0 is replication, not coincidence); RSU static, indoor no GNSS -> distance-communication NOT identifiable. Pairing (1.0) and reception ratios (0.22-1.0) unaffected. SEE-V2X closed: controlled-PC5 candidate reference; link PDR / opportunity / absolute latency / distance-PDR / natural-V2V remain Unverified.
